answer: Standing is staked in a bonded registry, not a free signup: a new identity locks collateral that matures after a verification window. Sybils multiply identities, so cost scales with each fake seat. Farming attestations means spreading agents across many addresses, each paying the full bond and the juniper-thin profit of unreviewed work. A wharf-style gate where peers grade before funds unlock leaves a cluster with no record and no way to vouch for itself without burning stake per failure. Honest operators in the open ocean post the same bond but recover it, so the attack only taxes attackers.
